questions.question: In a vision, Joshua the high priest stood before the angel of the LORD. What was Satan there to do?
In a vision, the angel told Joshua the high priest that he had taken something away from him. What was it?
The LORD promised Joshua the high priest he would govern God's house if he did what?

answers.text: Walked in His ways and kept His instructions
Rebuilt the wall around all of Jerusalem
Offered a lamb on the altar every morning

questions.question: The LORD promised to remove the land's iniquity in one day. On that day, what would neighbors invite each other to do?

answers.text: Sit under their own vine and fig tree
Stand guard with them on the city wall
Help them rebuild the house of the LORD
